title: Functoriality of the etale H1 of G_m and the Picard group
statement: Let $X$ be a curve over an algebraically closed field $k$ and $Y$ a curve over an algebraically closed field $k'$ [def-sc-curves] (possibly $k\neq k'$), and let $u:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Let $c_u:u^{-1}\mathbf G_{m,X}\to\mathbf G_{m,Y}$ be the comparison morphism of abelian sheaves on $Y_{\mathrm{Et}}$ adjoint to the pullback-of-units map $\mathbf G_{m,X}\to u_*\mathbf G_{m,Y}$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], and let $u^*$ be the cohomology pullback map [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. Under the canonical isomorphisms $\operatorname{Pic}(X)\cong H^1(X_{\mathrm{Et}},\mathbf G_{m,X})$ and $\operatorname{Pic}(Y)\cong H^1(Y_{\mathrm{Et}},\mathbf G_{m,Y})$ of [lem-sc-h1-gm-pic], the map $H^1(c_u)\circ u^*:H^1(X_{\mathrm{Et}},\mathbf G_{m,X})\to H^1(Y_{\mathrm{Et}},\mathbf G_{m,Y})$ corresponds to pullback of invertible modules [def-sc-invertible-module], [def-pc-module-pullback], $[\mathcal L]\mapsto[u^*\mathcal L]$; equivalently, it sends the class of the etale $\mathbf G_{m,X}$-torsor $\underline{\operatorname{Isom}}(\mathcal O_X,\mathcal L)$ to that of $\underline{\operatorname{Isom}}(\mathcal O_Y,u^*\mathcal L)$. In degree zero, under $H^0=\Gamma$ [lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-degree-zero], $H^0(c_u)\circ u^*$ is pullback of global units $\mathcal O_X(X)^\times\to\mathcal O_Y(Y)^\times$.
